home.title: Book your visit in a chat,
home.lead: Plan a museum day in English or Hindi. Choose an entry pass, an exhibition or a show, pick a time slot and pay securely. Your QR ticket arrives in the same conversation.
home.feature1Body: Quick replies and plain typing both work, in English, Hindi or Hinglish.
home.feature2Body: Live availability before you pay, so the galleries never feel crowded.
home.feature3Body: The ticket arrives with a scannable code. Show it on your phone and walk in.
home.timingsBody: Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 – 18:00. Last entry at 17:15. Closed on Mondays and national holidays.
home.ticketBody: General entry from {{price}}. Children under 3 enter free.
home.exhibitionsBody: Hands-on galleries, a planetarium dome and live robotics — book a slot for any of them in the same chat.

chat.title: Museum assistant
chat.subtitle: Bookings · timings · cancellations
chat.placeholder: Type a message — English or हिन्दी
chat.disclaimer: This demo simulates payment — no card details are collected and no money moves.
chat.welcome: Namaste! I can book your museum tickets, share timings and prices, or cancel a booking. What would you like to do?
chat.askTarget: What would you like to visit?
chat.askWhichExhibition: Which exhibition would you like to see?
chat.askWhichShow: Which show would you like to watch?
chat.askDate: Which day are you visiting? Pick a date below or type it — for example 2026-11-20.
chat.askSlot: Pick a time slot. Sold-out slots cannot be chosen.
chat.askCounts: How many tickets for each category?
chat.askVisitor: Who should the ticket be issued to?
chat.summaryIntro: Please check the booking before paying.
chat.payFailed: The payment did not go through. Try again, or cancel this booking.
chat.ticketIssued: Payment confirmed. Here is your ticket — show the QR code at the gate.
chat.infoMenu: Ask me about the museum. Pick a topic, or type your question.
chat.cancelAsk: Share the booking code and the email or phone used for the booking, and I will cancel it.
chat.cancelSuccess: Booking {{code}} is cancelled. Any captured payment is refunded to the original method.
chat.cancelFailed: I could not cancel that booking. Check the code and contact details, then try again.
chat.languageAsk: Choose a language. Your booking details stay exactly as they are.
chat.help: I can book a ticket, share timings and prices, cancel a booking, or switch language. Tap an option or type your request.
chat.slotEmpty: Every slot for that day is sold out. Would you like to try another date?
chat.slotConflict: That slot filled up just before payment. Here are the current slots — please pick another.
chat.loadFailed: I could not load that information. Check your connection and try again.
chat.fallback: Sorry, I did not catch that. Let's start from the main menu.
chat.fallbackRetry: Sorry, I did not get that. Tap an option below, or reply “menu” to start again.
chat.invalidDate: That date is in the past or not a valid date. Pick today or a later day.
chat.invalidCounts: Please add at least one ticket.
chat.invalidVisitor: Enter a name and at least one contact — a valid email or a 10-digit phone number.
chat.slotSoldOut: That slot just sold out. Please pick another.
chat.dateHint: Pick today or a later date.
chat.countsHint: At least one ticket is needed.
chat.visitorHint: Used for the ticket and any cancellation. Fill this in, or send the name and contact as a message.
chat.summaryHint: You can change any detail before paying.
chat.paymentNote: Simulated payment — no real money moves. Pick an outcome to test the flow.
